title: A Universal Time | Auto Get Delta Script, For The Delta
features:
for the delta is the longest questline in AUT so we automated the whole thing
turn on one toggle, let it run, come back to your delta

it goes through all of it in order:

- khronos lab rank up to lead researcher

- mining laser

- enhanced protection

- first contact + harmonic decoder

- shrine

- all 3 designs (PLANET // SHAPER, crystallized, NUCLEAR-STAR)

- the 15 objective trial

- the convergence

it checks where you're at and picks up from there, it won't redo stuff you finished

theres also continuous mode if you wanna get deltas back to back
it stops on its own if you run out of ucoins or ability slots so it won't sit there looping all night

hit preflight before you start and it'll tell you if anything is gonna block the run, takes like 5 seconds

you can put a webhook in and it pings you on discord when you get the delta, or when the run stops and why

headless mode is in there too if you're running a bunch of tabs

what you need:

- around 7M ucoins per run, most of it goes into the forced ascensions in the trial, that's the game's cost not ours

- potassium, volt, madium, delta or project real, solara and xeno don't work

- a run usually takes 4-5 hours
